Motor test

10% PWM

Remove propellers before testing. Fixed 10% · 2 seconds per press.

Test keys

Press m to enter motor test, then 1–4 to run one motor at a time. Any other key stops and exits. Press i to test IMU; any key stops it. Commands need no Enter. Brushed motors via MOSFET only.

Position & rotation

Stored on device

Motor numbers identify GPIO outputs. Assign each output to its physical corner and observed rotation. These settings do not reverse the motor electrically.

OutputFrame positionObserved rotation

Connect and reload to read saved motor settings.

How to verify

Remove propellers. Mark the drone nose, test M1–M4 one at a time, then record each motor's corner and rotation. Save stores the layout and verifies readback. An unassigned motor remains unknown. The firmware does not yet implement flight control or validate the airframe for flight.

Local updater & recovery help

For flash operations, run make web in the firmware repository and open http://127.0.0.1:8080. Static hosting supports monitoring and parameter export. Build the release with make firmware-bundle.

After a verified write, reset into Recovery. Send BOOT_MAIN to start Flight. Readback verifies bytes, not runtime behavior. GPIO2 low for 3 seconds at reset selects Recovery; GPIO9 BOOT + reset enters ROM repair.
